source_text: Estimated cost put to tender | Rs. 44 Lakhs

Should have satisfactorily completed the works as mentioned below during the last 7 years ending previous day of last date of submission of bids i. Three similar works each costing not less than 40% of the estimated cost. i.e. Rs. 17.60 (or) ii. Two similar works each costing not less than 60% of the estimated cost i.e. Rs. 26.40 Lakhs (or) iii. One similar work costing not less than 80% of the estimated cost i.e. Rs. 35.20 Lakhs
average annual financial turnover not less than 30% of the estimated cost
during the last three years ending 31st March of preceding year (i.e. 31/03/2025)
Should not have incurred any loss in more than two years during the last five years ending 31/03/2025
have a solvency of 40% of the Estimated cost of the work
